subject.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime

question: After the AGENTS indentation fix, should maintainers approve this exact-head removal of the qa-matrix package plus the reusable Matrix QA Live workflow secret and dependency boundary?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes a lockfile/package graph, a source-checkout plugin boundary, plugin SDK QA runner types, and a secret-bearing reusable workflow; those are ownership and security-boundary choices automation should not approve on its own.

options.title: Fix indentation and approve exact head
options.body: Repair the remaining docs finding, then have dependency/security workflow owners approve the exact reviewed SHA before merge.

options.title: Split workflow routing out
options.body: Land the QA Lab runtime consolidation separately and move reusable release workflow routing and secret handling to a smaller security-reviewed PR.

options.title: Pause the retirement
options.body: Keep the branch draft until package ownership and release QA workflow owners are ready to accept the churn together.

recommendation.title: Fix indentation and approve exact head
recommendation.body: Repair the remaining docs finding, then have dependency/security workflow owners approve the exact reviewed SHA before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workflow/security-boundary history and CODEOWNERS-protected surfaces make this the best available owner for the dependency and secret-boundary approval.
